subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four exact-SHA guards are repaired, should the security owner approve this grouped action update for the dependency-guard and CodeQL workflows?
rationale: The source audit found no concrete security regression, but the PR carries the protected security label and modifies third-party execution in CODEOWNERS-protected workflows.

options.title: Repair then security review
options.body: Synchronize the four guards, rerun exact-head validation, and request the required security-owner review before merge.

options.title: Recreate a narrower update
options.body: Close or recreate the grouped update as smaller action-specific PRs if the combined security review is not desirable.

recommendation.title: Repair then security review
recommendation.body: Synchronize the four guards, rerun exact-head validation, and request the required security-owner review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the security-sensitive dependency-guard workflow and test to this team.
